_comment: memd SessionStart hook for Codex CLI. Copy this into your project's .codex/hooks.json (merging with any existing hooks). It auto-creates a minimal .memd/project_scope.json when missing, refreshes memory.md, and kicks a background consolidation when enough new chunks have accumulated. Set MEMD_AUTO_SCOPE=0 or add .memd-skip in the repo root to opt out.
